seal.statement: Bulk evidence that the rs-raft lineage (epic raft-rs-full-cutover and its quests) committed under solve/ (about 103 MB of open-quest evidence, 30 archives, 5 files over 1 MiB, and the 22 files a superseded quest keeps beyond its sealed claim) is relocated to the existing solve-evidence store through the existing evidence owner and removed from the tree, so that the unchanged 20 MiB active-state budget, the closed-quest shape rule and the no-archive rule hold again on this lineage. Every removed file is captured first in an uploaded bundle whose re-download hashed and whose per-file bytes match both the committed relocation inventory and the original blob at the recorded source commit; required proof artifacts and material still consumed by commands, probes, tests, reviews or implementation work stay in the tree; a committed inventory maps every old path to its archived bundle; and future bulk evidence has a documented, tool-supported route through the store so this does not recur. No history is rewritten.
